notes.title: Studio Grimm - Demo Now Available & Steam Next Fest Participation!!!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45171679/266b24c31290d996ba2afffa146f2de42c485fba.png[/img]

We’re excited to announce that the GrimmKitchen demo is now available!
Plus, we’ll be participating in Steam Next Fest starting on February 25, 2025!

[b]Embark on a fairy tale adventure, gather ingredients, and enjoy running a lively restaurant with your staff![/b]
Give it a try!

We’d love to hear your thoughts on SNS, and streaming is welcome!

Save data from the demo cannot be carried over to the full version. Thank you for your understanding.


Bug reports and feedback here!
